items.title: Frank Adams Interview, 1959-01-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] oh Robert Charles riot yeah that's what happened on I think it was on Saratoga... he was waiting for his wife... police ran up there... they started down to get his gun

ctx.x: uh can you tell us about that the Robert Charles riot

oh Robert Charles riot yeah that's what happened on I think it was on Saratoga between the Irada and and Clio somewhere around the other on the the woods side of the street like the cafe over there like the rich cafe and uh he was waiting for his wife and so they said and police ran up there and the colored woman went and called the police and said he was standing around there so long she didn't know what he's waiting around there for and what come to find out the man was waiting for his wife to see his wife and…
The police started for their guns? Yeah, they started for their guns first.
